description: Deterministic seeded fixture repo for the W1 ablation bench. Stable ids, fixed order. Seeded into the live arm before missions run so the store has a known baseline. No timestamps/random data — byte-stable across loads.

crystals.summary: fixture-acme authenticates users with argon2id password hashing
crystals.content: The fixture-acme service hashes passwords with argon2id (memory=64MB, iterations=3). Migrated off bcrypt in release 2.0.

crystals.summary: fixture-acme uses PostgreSQL 16 as the primary datastore
crystals.content: Primary datastore is PostgreSQL 16. Connection pooling via pgbouncer in transaction mode.

crystals.summary: fixture-acme deploys via blue-green on Kubernetes
crystals.content: Deployment strategy is blue-green on Kubernetes; traffic shifted by updating the active Service selector.

crystals.summary: fixture-acme API rate limit is 200 requests per minute per token
crystals.content: Public API enforces a 200 req/min per-token sliding-window rate limit; 429 on exceed.

crystals.summary: fixture-acme release checklist runs the full test suite then tags vN
crystals.content: Release procedure: run full suite, bump version, tag vN, push image to registry, blue-green cutover.

crystals.summary: fixture-acme uses Conventional Commits for all changes
crystals.content: All commits follow Conventional Commits; CI rejects non-conforming subjects on protected branches.
